title: Neural networks and penalised regression for glioma survival prediction (analysis code and reproducibility materials)
description: TCGA-CDR benchmark of neural networks and penalised regression, with external evaluation in Gravendeel and REMBRANDT. Includes analysis and figure code, manuscript figures, and aggregate supplementary tables. The TCGA development cohort comprises 663 adults.
